note.note:
Consult Summary:
- Acute gastroenteritis suspected with guidance for hydration and symptomatic care; follow-up if not improved within 48 hours.

History:
- Presenting complaint: Several days of profuse watery diarrhea with mid-lower abdominal cramps and associated nausea/vomiting.
- Onset/duration: Symptoms began about 3 days ago.
- Symptom progression: Diarrhea is frequent (nearly hourly) and watery; pain is crampy and intermittent, reported around 6/10 at times.
- Associated symptoms: Feels hot; no blood in stools reported; decreased urine frequency noted; had at least one episode of vomiting, particularly after dairy (milk).
- Exposures/triggers: Brother with similar symptoms for ~5 days; no clear trigger identified.
- Diet/fluids: Drinking water but feels fluids are passing through; had lunch today with loose stools.
- PMH/medications/allergies: Otherwise fit and well; no regular medications; taking Paracetamol PRN; no known drug allergies.
- Social history: Lives with sister and mother; works in an office in Central London; smokes socially; consumes alcohol occasionally.
- Family history: Father with colon cancer; currently in advanced stage (unclear details).

Examination:
- None documented.

Impression:
- Gastroenteritis (acute gastroenteritis) likely viral infection.

Plan:
- Hydration: encourage clear fluids; consider oral rehydration solution (Diarolyte) for electrolyte replacement; dose/route/frequency not documented.
- Diet: start with clear fluids, then soft diet (e.g., soup, mashed foods) as tolerated; gradually reintroduce solids.
- Medications: continue Paracetamol as needed for fever/pain; dose/route/frequency not documented; avoid alcohol.
- Follow-up: if no improvement or signs of dehydration within 48 hours, contact clinic for reassessment.
- Antibacterials/antimetics: not prescribed at this time.

Quality checks (document_quality):
- Missing elements clinically expected: vital signs and formal physical examination details not documented; no specific dehydration assessment recorded.
- Internal conflicts: none identified.
- Transcript quality: overall clear; minor conversational filler; no contradictions detected.
